contexts.text: Under Foot, see this reference. AE 632:4.
Evils and falsities emerge... and disturb him...
Ye have troubled me to make me to stink () = to cause them to be abominated.
Behold, they were troubled () = that they were in a sad state.
Such do not disturb anyone within the Church, nor do they ever condemn others.
For there is nothing that disturbs him...
They induce such things as disturb the mind.

To trouble the waters with the feet () = to defile and pervert the truths of faith through the scientifics which are of the Natural; and to confound their rivers = and thus to do the same to intelligence.
Let him take care not to disturb the Church.
Works without judgment which they will throw down from truth. Signified.
Heresies come forth, and the Church is disturbed and rent asunder.

His presence would bend to itself the thoughts of those who are in the Society, and thus disturb the influx from the Divine there: (but) when they think abstractedly... the thought diffuses itself... thus without the disturbance of any Society.

I will disturb all the people () = the consternation of all falsities... The reason to disturb = consternation, is that they who are in consternation are disturbed in mind and heart... as is evident from Zechariah: In that day a great disturbance from Jehovah shall be among them...
They induce anxieties which disturb the happiness of the Angels.
At their first entrance... they began to be disturbed in their understanding...
Lest anything should flow in to disturb its states.
This form... is disturbed in human minds... Hence a confusion or disturbance like that of the builders of the tower of Babel.
On the disturbance of the understanding by the dissension of Spirits.
Lest they should be disturbed in their heavenly joys...
This sphere ascends to the rational sphere, and disturbs it.
So that the celestial... began to be disturbed...
That they were thrown down and cast out of Heaven. SE 409:2.
They could not be disturbed by phantasies.
When the dragon was thrown down from Heaven...
That they perceive the sense of the words without disturbance from words.
When the waters thereof... are troubled ().
Therefore He says: Let not your heart be troubled ().
To be troubled, etc. () = to be entirely changed as to state.

To be troubled, etc () = their states when they are perishing, and in their place there enter falsities and evils; thus the states of the Church when it is being vastated as to goods and desolated as to truths.
The disturbance of all things from the primes of the Church to its ultimates. Signified.
